# n4 - The return schema and the gate that writes one transition

`NodeReturn.parse(text)` reads one YAML document against a closed schema and returns a struct or a
named failure. Keys: `node`, `status`, `commit`, `summary`, `findings`, `proposed_nodes`,
`proposed_edges`, `question`, `reason`. Anything unparsable or off-schema is
`failed_verification reason=return_unparsable`.

`RunnerAbsorb.absorb(context, node:, return_path:)` is the gate that turns one return into exactly
one transition line. It runs the checks in a fixed order and stops at the first refusal: core
integrity, schema, diff scope, named tests exist, merge, suite. Only a clean pass through all six
writes `done` (D18). Every other path writes `failed_verification`, `needs_decision` or `blocked`,
with the reason that stopped it.

Findings land as one capped Insight line per node per return under `### Findings`. The rest of the
return is discarded (D45, C27). `Insights.append_insight` never creates that subsection, so this
node creates it when absent; without the heading, `outcome-report` reads no findings at all.

Every line the gate writes carries `gates=`, a plus-joined list of the checks that actually ran,
from the closed set `integrity`, `schema`, `scope`, `named_tests`, `merge`, `suite`. It is a
required ledger field on both `done` and `failed_verification` (D20).

The entry sub-schemas are pinned here, not left to the implementer: a `proposed_nodes` entry
carries `kind`, `title` and `needs`, with optional `files` and `budget`; a `proposed_edges` entry
carries `from` and `to`.

## n4 failure-mode matrix
| Row | Operation | Failure mode | Test |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4.1 | Parse a well-formed return | The happy path fails and no node can ever reach `done` | `node_return_test#test_valid_return_parses` |
| 4.2 | Refuse text that is not YAML | A raw transcript is read as a return and its prose becomes fields | `node_return_test#test_non_yaml_is_return_unparsable` |
| 4.3 | Refuse YAML that is not a mapping | A YAML list or scalar reaches the field readers and raises `NoMethodError` | `node_return_test#test_non_mapping_is_return_unparsable` |
| 4.4 | Refuse an unknown key | An executor invents a field the runner silently drops, and the contract erodes with nobody noticing | `node_return_test#test_unknown_key_is_refused` |
| 4.5 | Refuse an unknown `status` | A misspelled status falls through to a default and a failed node reads as done | `node_return_test#test_unknown_status_is_refused` |
| 4.6 | Require `commit` on a work node's `done` | `done` lands with no evidence at all, which is exactly what D44 refuses one layer down | `node_return_test#test_done_without_commit_is_refused` |
| 4.7 | Require `question` on `needs_decision` | The loop stops and prints no question, so the owner is asked nothing | `node_return_test#test_needs_decision_without_question_is_refused` |
| 4.8 | Require `reason` on `failed_verification` and `blocked` | The ledger records a failure with no cause and the retry repeats it | `node_return_test#test_failure_without_reason_is_refused` |
| 4.9 | Refuse a return whose `node` is not the dispatched node | An executor's return is absorbed against another node and closes work that never ran | `node_return_test#test_node_mismatch_is_refused` |
| 4.10 | Cap and coerce `findings` to strings | A nested structure lands in an Insight line and breaks the guarded append | `node_return_test#test_findings_are_coerced_and_capped` |
| 4.11 | Survive a YAML alias or anchor bomb | A crafted return exhausts memory and takes the session down | `node_return_test#test_aliases_are_refused` |
| 4.12 | Survive invalid UTF-8 in the return | `ArgumentError: invalid byte sequence` escapes the parser and kills the step | `node_return_test#test_invalid_utf8_does_not_raise` |
| 4.13 | Check core integrity before writing any transition | A drifted engine writes the transition, so the refusal that was supposed to catch it ran under the code it was checking | `runner_absorb_test#test_integrity_checked_before_transition` |
| 4.14 | Write `blocked reason=core_integrity` on drift | Drift is reported and the step continues anyway | `runner_absorb_test#test_drift_blocks_and_records_reason` |
| 4.15 | Record `--allow-core-drift` on the line when it is used | The override is invisible and a run under a drifted core looks identical to a clean one | `runner_absorb_test#test_allow_core_drift_is_recorded` |
| 4.16 | Refuse a work node's diff touching a path outside `files:` | An executor edits anything it likes and the declared surface means nothing | `runner_absorb_test#test_diff_outside_files_fails_verification` |
| 4.17 | Refuse any diff at all on a verify node | A verify node writes the code it is meant to judge | `runner_absorb_test#test_any_diff_on_verify_fails_verification` |
| 4.18 | Refuse any diff at all on a research node | A research node commits code nobody planned | `runner_absorb_test#test_any_diff_on_research_fails_verification` |
| 4.19 | Refuse `done` when the matrix names a test file that does not exist | The node claims a test as its proof and the file was never written | `runner_absorb_test#test_named_test_missing_fails_verification` |
| 4.20 | Merge cleanly and record the merge commit | The node branch is never merged and the intent branch ships without the work | `runner_absorb_test#test_clean_merge_records_commit` |
| 4.21 | Route a conflict entirely inside `files:` to `failed_verification` | A conflict the retry can fix stops the whole run for an owner decision | `runner_absorb_test#test_conflict_inside_files_fails_verification` |
| 4.22 | Route a conflict touching a path outside `files:` to `needs_decision` with the paths | A graph error the owner owns is retried blindly until the cap | `runner_absorb_test#test_conflict_outside_files_needs_decision_with_paths` |
| 4.23 | Run the project's tests and write `suite=` | The runner takes the executor's word for green, which D18 exists to refuse | `runner_absorb_test#test_done_line_carries_runner_measured_suite` |
| 4.24 | Write `failed_verification reason=suite_red` on a red suite | A red suite writes `done` and the intent ships broken | `runner_absorb_test#test_red_suite_fails_verification` |
| 4.25 | Run the suite only after a clean merge | The suite measures the node branch, not the integrated tree, and passes on code that does not integrate | `runner_absorb_test#test_suite_runs_on_merged_tree` |
| 4.26 | Write exactly one transition per return | Two lines land for one return and the attempt count is wrong forever | `runner_absorb_test#test_one_transition_per_return` |
| 4.27 | Append one capped Insight line per return under `### Findings` | Findings are lost, or a long return floods the record | `runner_absorb_test#test_findings_append_one_capped_line` |
| 4.28 | Discard the rest of the return | Executor prose reaches the record and the record stops being the runner's own account | `runner_absorb_test#test_return_body_is_not_recorded` |
| 4.29 | Keep the node worktree on a failing absorb | The evidence for the failure is deleted with the worktree | `runner_absorb_test#test_failing_absorb_keeps_worktree` |
| 4.30 | Absorb a return for a node that is not `running` | A stale return closes a node that was already reclaimed and re-dispatched | `runner_absorb_test#test_return_for_non_running_node_is_refused` |
| 4.31 | Write `gates=` on every `done` line (D20, meld of blocker 1) | `gates` is a required field, so `append_transition` raises before touching the file and no node can ever reach `done` | `runner_absorb_test#test_done_line_carries_gates` |
| 4.32 | Write `gates=` on every `failed_verification` line | Same refusal, on the failure path, so no failure can be recorded either | `runner_absorb_test#test_failed_verification_line_carries_gates` |
| 4.33 | Record in `gates=` only the checks that actually ran | A failure at check two claims all six ran and the line overstates what was verified | `runner_absorb_test#test_gates_lists_only_checks_that_ran` |
| 4.34 | Write `holder=` on every line the gate writes (meld of major 10) | An unattributed `done` wedges the node: `running` is refused at exit 5 and `reclaimed` at exit 6, and no successor becomes ready | `runner_absorb_test#test_every_written_line_carries_holder` |
| 4.35 | Create the `### Findings` subsection when it is absent (meld of major 13) | `Insights.append_insight` never creates the heading, so `outcome-report` splits on it and reads nothing | `runner_absorb_test#test_findings_subsection_created_when_absent` |
| 4.36 | Synthesize the `question=` for a conflict outside `files:` (D29, meld of major 12) | `needs_decision` requires `question`, so the append raises and the conflict is never recorded | `runner_absorb_test#test_conflict_needs_decision_carries_question` |
| 4.37 | Refuse a malformed `proposed_nodes` entry (D29, meld of major 17) | A string where a mapping belongs reaches the proposal writer and raises out of the step | `node_return_test#test_malformed_proposed_node_entry_is_refused` |
| 4.38 | Refuse a malformed `proposed_edges` entry | Same, for edges | `node_return_test#test_malformed_proposed_edge_entry_is_refused` |
| 4.39 | Write `suite=none` and record `suite:absent` in `gates` when the project records no verify command (D29, meld of major 23) | `default_project_reader` returns nil and the sixth check has no defined behavior: `done` either lands unverified or the node blocks forever | `runner_absorb_test#test_absent_verify_command_writes_suite_none` |
| 4.40 | Report the merge commit when the ledger append fails after a landed merge (D30, meld of major 15) | The merge is on the intent branch, the suite has run, and no line records any of it | `runner_absorb_test#test_append_failure_after_merge_reports_commit` |
| 4.41 | Remove the node worktree only after the `done` line lands | The worktree is gone and the transition that justified removing it never landed | `runner_absorb_test#test_worktree_removed_after_done_line_lands` |
| 4.42 | Keep the return file as `packets/<node>--a<N>.return` (D30, meld of minor 28) | The evidence behind a `done` line is discarded and the line cannot be audited | `runner_absorb_test#test_return_file_kept_beside_packet` |
| 4.43 | Record drift with the field key `core_drift` (D30, meld of minor 27) | An unnamed field, or one outside `[a-z_]+`, is emitted and the parser can never read it back | `runner_absorb_test#test_core_drift_field_key` |
| 4.44 | Re-render `graph.md` `## Status` after the transition (D28) | The graph's Status table still reads `planned` after the node is done | `runner_absorb_test#test_absorb_rerenders_graph_status` |
| 4.45 | Register `node_return.rb` and `runner_absorb.rb` in `core_files` (D25) | `install_sync_test` goes red as soon as `scripts/runner` requires them | `install_sync_test#test_core_files_match_disk` |

## Steps
1. Red: the matrix's tests above, committed before any code.
2. Write `NodeReturn` and `RunnerAbsorb`, and wire absorption into `step`.
3. Green, then the whole suite at its baseline.
